title: BC Forest Planning and Practices Regulation
description: Selected evidence and threshold screens across planning, practice and roads, with the cutblock size exceptions, the green-up test for adjacent cutblocks, secondary structure in pine leading stands and the limits of a forest operations plan exemption. Consult the complete source catalogue for companion duties, discretion and exceptions.

facts.label: A §92.1 conflict with a Part 4 or Part 5 requirement is asserted

Is the harvest under a cutting permit, a forestry licence to cut without cutting permits or a timber sale licence, outside §43.1(4) (community forest, BC Timber Sales licence to cut, occupant or master licence to cut, permits or layout before the section, a §196(1)(a) cutblock, or a cruise showing pine is not leading)?

Does the cutblock take in a targeted pine leading stand: pine leading on the government-endorsed forest cover map, at least 5 ha, with at least 700 stems/ha of suitable secondary structure 6 m or taller (or 900 stems/ha 4 m or taller) at least 1.6 m apart, in a listed area such as the Prince George or Lakes TSA (§1(4))?

(2)(c) Protecting a community, or an area the minister agreed, from wildfire
(2)(d) Seed collection leaving an opening of 1 ha or less

rules.title: Cutblock size · 40 ha regions
rules.finding: The net area to be reforested exceeds the regional limit, and no §64(2)–(4) exception lifts it.

actions.description: Confirm the net area and region. Reduce the net area to the limit, or document an exception: the harvest purpose or natural disturbance design under (2), 40% basal area retained under (3), or the tree-length geometry under (4).

rules.title: Cutblock size · 60 ha regions
rules.finding: The net area to be reforested exceeds the regional limit, and no §64(2)–(4) exception lifts it.

actions.description: Confirm the net area and region. Reduce the net area to the limit, or document an exception: the harvest purpose or natural disturbance design under (2), 40% basal area retained under (3), or the tree-length geometry under (4).

rules.title: Cutblock size · exception relied on
rules.finding: The net area exceeds the regional limit and relies on a §64(2)–(4) exception, which also lifts the adjacency rule (§65(4)).

actions.description: Keep the evidence for the exception: the damage, treatment or natural disturbance design and the block's structure after harvest under (2); pre-harvest and retained basal area under (3); or the tree-length buffers measured from stand height under (4).

rules.title: Adjacent cutblocks
rules.finding: An adjacent existing cutblock has not greened up under §65(3), and the new cutblock with the non-conforming portions beside it exceeds the §64(1) size.

actions.description: Measure stocking and the height of the tallest 10% on each adjacent existing cutblock, by the whole net area or its nearer half. Defer harvest, reduce the combined area to the §64(1) limit, or record the FSP result or strategy that replaces §65(2).

rules.title: Wildlife tree retention · annual group
rules.finding: Reported retention is below the numeric minimum.

actions.description: Check related retention geometry, collective accounting under subsection (3), exemptions and plan evidence.

rules.title: Wildlife tree retention · individual cutblock
rules.finding: Reported retention is below the numeric minimum.

actions.description: Check related retention geometry, collective accounting under subsection (3), exemptions and plan evidence.

rules.title: Predominantly sensitive soils
rules.finding: The entered measurement triggers the 5 % review screen.

actions.description: Review stump removal, windthrow, temporary access and rehabilitation under §35(4). Record the measured area, denominator and conditions.

rules.title: Other soils
rules.finding: The entered measurement triggers the 10 % review screen.

actions.description: Review stump removal, windthrow, temporary access and rehabilitation under §35(4). Record the measured area, denominator and conditions.

rules.title: Cumulative disturbance on overlapping authorizations
rules.finding: The entered measurement triggers the 25 % review screen.

actions.description: Reconcile disturbances from both holders and verify the overlap denominator.

rules.title: Permanent access footprint
rules.finding: The entered measurement triggers the 7 % review screen.

actions.description: Document constraints or access beyond the block. Show why exceedance is as little as practicable.

rules.title: Coarse woody debris
rules.finding: The entered measurement triggers the 4 logs/ha review screen.

actions.description: Verify region, log dimensions, count and denominator. Record any §68(2) exemption.

rules.title: Harvest in a wildlife tree retention area
rules.finding: Mature seral attributes are recorded as absent.

actions.description: Review field evidence for the related cutblock and §67 restriction.

rules.title: Minimum shortened public review

actions.description: Verify the publication and closure dates. Even an authorized shorter period has a ten-day floor.

rules.title: Shortened public review authorization

actions.description: Obtain the ministerial decision, grounds and evidence of notice on both required channels.

actions.description: Check submission receipts and any ministerial determination before relying on the amendment.

rules.title: Standing basal area in riparian management zone
rules.finding: Standing basal area is below the applicable table percentage.

actions.description: Verify the preharvest denominator and representativeness under (1)(b). Review stream-bank stability under §52(2), including applicable S6 sites.

rules.title: Approved FSP landscape result or strategy
rules.finding: Approved FSP landscape result or strategy needs a case-specific determination.

actions.description: Verify whether the agreement holder or timber sales manager submitted the proposed plan with the §9 result or strategy for the relevant area and obtained approval. Record the exact §64(1) or §65(2) consequence.

rules.title: Approved FSP stand-level result or strategy
rules.finding: Approved FSP stand-level result or strategy needs a case-specific determination.

actions.description: Verify the submitted and approved §9.1 result or strategy, activity area, plan holder and tenure. Record the consequence for §66 or §67.

rules.title: Ministerial FOP practice exemption
rules.finding: A §4.51 exemption of a listed provision needs the minister’s decision and the plan’s measure.

actions.description: Use the source table to match the exact subsection and matter. Verify the FOP measure, ministerial assessment of equivalent effectiveness and actual decision.

rules.title: FOP exemption claimed for a provision §4.51 does not list

when.value: A provision the table does not list (such as §68 or §52(1))

rules.finding: Section 4.51 lets the minister exempt only the provisions its table lists; the provision claimed still applies to the cutblock.

actions.description: Apply the provision as written. §68 coarse woody debris and §52(1) basal area are not in the table.

rules.title: Conflict with an established objective
rules.finding: Conflict with an established objective needs a case-specific determination.

actions.description: Verify the approved FSP result or strategy, established objective, conflict, exemption and any conditions. Check instruments already in effect under (3).

rules.title: Secondary structure in a targeted pine leading stand
rules.finding: The harvest takes a targeted pine leading stand without keeping its secondary structure, and no §43.1 exception is relied on.

actions.description: Lay the block out to retain an adequate stocking density of suitable secondary structure, or document the exception that applies. A retained tree counts toward the stocking standard (§43.1(3)).

rules.title: Pine leading stand · exception relied on

value: (1)(a) Felling a safety hazard, with no other practicable option
(1)(b) Building a road, with no other practicable location
(2)(b) At least 30% of the pine holds live mountain pine beetle
(2)(c) Protecting a community, or an area the minister agreed, from wildfire
(2)(d) Seed collection leaving an opening of 1 ha or less

rules.finding: The harvest removes the secondary structure under a §43.1 exception, which needs its evidence on file.

actions.description: Record the evidence: no practicable option for a hazard tree or road; the blowdown risk; a beetle survey showing at least 30% of the pine attacked at harvest; the community or area the minister agreed to before harvest; or a seed collection opening of 1 ha or less.

rules.title: Bank stability on a direct tributary
rules.finding: Trees that hold the bank or channel of a small stream flowing directly into a larger stream or sensitive marine area must be kept in enough number to keep it stable.

actions.description: Mark the trees that hold the bank and channel in the riparian management zone and keep them, whoever cuts there: §52(2) binds every authorized person, not only minor tenures.
